newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BUDGET SURPLUS 36.1 MLN LATS BY JULY 31.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BUDGET SURPLUS 36.1 MLN LATS BY JULY 31.

text.p: Latvia currently has a 36.1 million lat budget surplus, made up of income of 328.86 million and expenditure of 292.75, the state exchequer said on Friday.

The exchequer said in a statement that total state debt came to 414.34 lats, made up of mostly of borrowing in government T-bills, worth 134.59 million lats, International Monetary Fund credits of 61.28 million lats and World Bank credits worth 63.27 million lats.
Latvia had been planning a balanced 1997 budget but due to a short-fall in tax revenues a deficit of 10 million to 12 million lats seems likely.
